title: NE-YO, Sonu Nigam, MC Jin, and former WMG exec Jonathan Serbin launch Pacific Music Group (Music Business Worldwide)
notes: MBW, Murray Stassen, 2025-11-24. PMG = HK-based, founded by NE-YO, Sonu Nigam, MC Jin, Jonathan Serbin (CEO, ex-Warner Music Asia Co-President). Pan-Asian focus, pop/R&B/hip-hop/electronic imprints. Signed TaTa (Stage Zero) Mar 2026. NOT Black-hip-hop-avatar focused. No VC disclosed. Supports Q3 + Q2 negative.
